import os
import warnings
import re

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# Set random state for reproducibility
RANDOM_STATE = 42
np.random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)

# Paths based on actual data structure
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SUBMISSION_PATH = "./submission/submission.csv"

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(SUBMISSION_PATH), exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Drop date column for text processing, keep for submission
texts_train = train_df["Comment"].astype(str)
y_train = train_df["Insult"].values
texts_test = test_df["Comment"].astype(str)

# Keep meta for submission
date_test = test_df["Date"]

print(f"Train labels distribution: {np.bincount(y_train)}")

# Split training data for validation - CLEAN HOLD-OUT
X_train_val, X_val, y_train_val, y_val = train_test_split(
    texts_train,
    y_train,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    stratify=y_train,
    shuffle=True,
)

print("Training model with combined word and character-level features...")

# Word-level TF-IDF Vectorization (from previous solution)
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=50000, min_df=2, max_df=0.95, lowercase=True
)

# FIT ONLY ON TRAINING VALIDATION DATA
X_train_val_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_val)
X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val)

# Character-level TF-IDF Vectorization
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(2, 4),
    max_features=10000,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    lowercase=True,
)

X_train_val_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_val)
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val)

# Combine word and character features
X_train_val_combined = np.hstack(
    [X_train_val_word.toarray(), X_train_val_char.toarray()]
)
X_val_combined = np.hstack([X_val_word.toarray(), X_val_char.toarray()])

# Train Gradient Boosting classifier
gb_model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=4,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    subsample=0.8,
)
gb_model.fit(X_train_val_combined, y_train_val)

# Validate AUC on held-out set
gb_val_preds = gb_model.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]

# Train Logistic Regression on held-out validation
lr_model = LogisticRegression(
    class_weight="balanced",
    max_iter=2000,
    solver="lbfgs",
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    n_jobs=-1,
)
lr_model.fit(X_train_val_combined, y_train_val)

# Validate AUC on held-out set
lr_val_preds = lr_model.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]

# Ensemble predictions
ensemble_val_preds = (gb_val_preds + lr_val_preds) / 2
validation_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, ensemble_val_preds)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC Score (held-out ensemble): {validation_auc:.6f}")

# Transform ALL training data (val + train) to full dataset for final model
X_train_all = np.concatenate([texts_train.values], axis=0)
y_train_all = np.concatenate([y_train], axis=0)

# Fit vectorizers on ALL training data
word_vectorizer_full = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=50000, min_df=2, max_df=0.95, lowercase=True
)
char_vectorizer_full = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(2, 4),
    max_features=10000,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    lowercase=True,
)

X_train_all_word = word_vectorizer_full.fit_transform(X_train_all)
X_train_all_char = char_vectorizer_full.fit_transform(X_train_all)
X_train_all_combined = np.hstack(
    [X_train_all_word.toarray(), X_train_all_char.toarray()]
)

# Retrain models on ALL training data
gb_model_full = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=4,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    subsample=0.8,
)
gb_model_full.fit(X_train_all_combined, y_train_all)

lr_model_full = LogisticRegression(
    class_weight="balanced",
    max_iter=2000,
    solver="lbfgs",
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    n_jobs=-1,
)
lr_model_full.fit(X_train_all_combined, y_train_all)

# Transform test data
X_test_word = word_vectorizer_full.transform(texts_test)
X_test_char = char_vectorizer_full.transform(texts_test)
X_test_combined = np.hstack([X_test_word.toarray(), X_test_char.toarray()])

# Predict on test data from both models
gb_test_preds = gb_model_full.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]
lr_test_preds = lr_model_full.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]

# Ensemble predictions
test_preds = (gb_test_preds + lr_test_preds) / 2

# Clip predictions to [0, 1] for safety
test_preds = np.clip(test_preds, 0.0, 1.0)

# Prepare submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Comment": texts_test, "Date": date_test, "Insult": test_preds}
)

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_PATH}")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(f"Validation AUC (for reference, not submission score): {validation_auc:.6f}")
plan: I will improve the current Logistic Regression + TF-IDF solution by creating an ensemble with a Gradient Boosting classifier trained on the same word and character TF-IDF features. This ensemble approach will capture both the linear relationships that Logistic Regression finds and the non-linear interactions that Gradient Boosting excels at, which is particularly important for text-based insult detection where word combinations matter. The final prediction will be averaged from both model outputs to produce a more robust probability estimate.
